column1: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 05.09.2019

column2: Sufficient drinking water must be provided on the premises. Water shall be kept in clean containers and
shall be free from hazardous materials and combustible materials.
From raw materials to the premises to the production of finished food, there must be a proper process
Raw materials should be prepared and stored to prevent contamination.
